notes.title: Door Handle Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42922449/b65f86e3c9fd48ef0e847b5c19c18c4d73d16574.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=qV9X43IfMqk;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] Added door handles to give more options and control over how you want to clear rooms.
[*] Made physics improvements when the door hits an AI.
[*] Added door sound cue to help players realize there is something or someone blocking the door.
[*] Improved the door model and added a new texture
[*] Improved both hangers lighting
[*] More Updates on the way
[/list]

notes.title: Grip Update #2
notes.notes:
Another core grip improvement that improves the grips for every object in the game
More updates on the way

notes.title: Mag Release Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42922449/f9f6c96fc28b925a12049363eb944d727619025d.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=TyzSqu441OE;full][/previewyoutube]
Players can now use the mag release button to release their mags instead of taking it out by hand.

Also:
Fixed a bug that sneaked into the last patch which made it harder to grab mags.
Improved AK Mags LODs.

notes.title: Grip Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42922449/917881971d4de90cca9efd049a032235f8f662c7.png[/img]
It is now a lot easier to grip objects, I have done a lot of improvements on grips, I will be treating no news as good news and will be working on other areas of the game until I hear feedback on this. 

If anyone would still like to see improvements to the grips please let me know what objects or what parts of objects you would like to see improved.
